name: AI for Medical Practice Managers and Administrators
description: Follow one composite Texas physician group through six months of real decisions: fixing its phones with an AI agent, reaching no-show patients without overbooking the wrong ones, clearing a fax backlog with document AI, piloting ambient scribes, and finding the denial cause an AI analysis got wrong, while keeping patient data where it belongs and reporting honestly to the physician owners.
fieldOfStudy: AI in Health and Life Sciences

image.caption: Wirewalk Institute of AI badge: AI for Medical Practice Managers and Administrators

criteria.narrative:
To earn this certificate a learner must: complete all 14 lessons in 6 modules, play each of the course's 7 Decision Labs to an ending (the lab score does not count); and pass the final exam: 20 questions, 40 minutes, pass mark 80%, at most 3 attempts, with a 24-hour wait after a failed attempt.

The exam is taken online and is not proctored. The holder's identity is not verified; the name is the one on their account. This is a certificate of completion and assessment issued by Wirewalk Institute of AI. It is not an accreditation, academic credit, license, or a certification from any vendor. Details: https://institute.wirewalk.com/certification/#limits
